description: This header defines the public API for loading flatbuffer-serialized mobile modules in PyTorch JIT, including functions for parsing modules from raw bytes, files, or streams, as well as retrieving version and module information.

methods.name: parse_and_initialize_mobile_module
methods.description: Parses a mobile::Module from raw bytes, with options to copy tensor memory or reference data.

methods.name: parse_and_initialize_mobile_module_for_jit
methods.description: Parses a mobile::Module from raw bytes and extracts JIT-related metadata like sources and constants.

methods.name: load_mobile_module_from_file
methods.description: Loads a mobile::Module from a specified file.

methods.name: get_bytecode_version
methods.description: Retrieves the bytecode version from an input stream, filename, or byte array.

methods.name: get_module_info_from_flatbuffer
methods.description: Extracts module information from a given flatbuffer content.

methods.name: load_mobile_module_from_stream_with_copy
methods.description: Loads a mobile::Module from an input stream, copying the entire stream into memory.

methods.name: parse_flatbuffer_no_object
methods.description: Parses a flatbuffer to produce a mobile::Module without creating an object.

methods.name: register_flatbuffer_loader
methods.description: No-op function for registering the flatbuffer loader, possibly for future extension.
